# FilmCraft editorial interchange

Pinned source: https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/tree/8309f21a6c3f34ddf190af7fd9bfd913053a1fd5

Used under its MIT option. Copyright (c) 2026 ArtCraft Team and the FilmCraft contributors. The original MIT and Apache licenses are retained. No assets, codecs, UI, or media runtime were copied.

The time, geometry, color, project, CFB and interchange source modules are retained for real EDL, FCP7 XML, FCPXML, OTIO, AAF and OMF adapters. Manifests are scoped to this portable dependency closure. The media crate is an extraction of the upstream metadata and generator descriptions needed by the project model; it contains no decoder or substitute exporter. Upstream tests require their original workspace and are not represented as EditBay validation. EditBay owns native document conversion, source probing, fingerprinting and relinking.
